schema.official_task_name: Classification of bevacizumab treatment effectiveness from H&E whole-slide images
schema.class_id_rule: Class IDs follow the current official spreadsheet worksheet order: effective=0, invalid=1.

notes: Representative demonstration label schema and split file (not the final complete release). Derived from the PathTrove label file for TCIA Version 2 (286 slides). Each slide is linked to the official slide manifest (Ovarian Bevacizumab Response_05-28-2024.csv); image_name is the manifest slide_id plus .svs. 5 label-table names differ from the manifest only in spaces, hyphens, extension case or a trailing dot and were matched with the same patient ID. Slides whose patient ID differs between the two official tables, and patients carrying both response labels, are listed in excluded.csv. The split is a patient-level demonstration split (about 70/15/15 within each response class, seed pathtrove-bev-demo-v1); it is not an official split.
